headline: Going Commando refreshes progress and adds core-library matches
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 progress report rose from 5.60% to 5.75% matched code, catching up with 60 earlier function implementations. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Later work adds shared game routines and core-library implementations, so that refreshed figure does not cover every merge of the day.
highlights: #184 and #186 add optional compiler settings for retail instruction scheduling and register saves.
#185 classifies 150 kernel syscall stubs as original handwritten assembly, rather than failed C matches.
#191 adds a separate executable-data measure, starting at 0% because data still comes from original dumps.
#181, #188 and #192 retain near misses without matching credit.
#194 proposes another core-function batch and remains unmerged.
